To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
topic models provide a powerful method for organizing and exploring document collections.

topic modeling provides a powerful method for summarizing and organizing large collections of documents, that visualizing the results of topic modeling is useful for exploring the collection, that users can interact with the visualizations in ways that reveal the relationships between topics and documents, and that users can interact in ways that reveal relationships across the documents themselves.
we have developed an interactive visual interface that allows the user to explore the hidden themes in a document collection and the relationships between those themes and the documents themselves.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: How do we create an interface that summarizes and organizes documents for users? How do we reveal and exploit the structure of a topic model? How do we design a visualization that reveals the structure of a document collection?
(1) how to summarize and visualize topic models, (2) how to interact with these visualizations, and (3) what kinds of visual summaries are most effective for end-users.
(1) how we can visualize topic models; and (2) what visualizations are useful for end-users to understand and navigate large document collections.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is a way to visualize topic models that helps a user explore the structure of a corpus and understand its contents.
our method creates a navigator for exploring topic models.
we propose a method for visual exploration and navigation of a document collection using the output of a fitted topic model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have created an interactive system for exploring a topic model.
we present a method to visualize topic models, and we demonstrate its use with a case study.
we present a method and system for visualizing the structure that topic models discover.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use a topic model to create an easily explorable corpus.
topic models can be used as a navigational tool for exploring a corpus.
a topic model provides a useful structure for exploring a collection.
